description: This file exports ONNX operators for PyTorch's ONNX export, specifically for opset 17, including functions for layer normalization and STFT, and defines related symbolic functions and helpers.

methods.name: layer_norm
methods.description: Defines the symbolic representation of the LayerNormalization ONNX operator for a given input tensor, including handling default weights and biases.

methods.name: quantized_layer_norm
methods.description: Defines the symbolic representation of the quantized LayerNorm operator, including dequantization and re-quantization steps.

methods.name: _compute_edge_sizes
methods.description: Helper function to compute the left and right edge sizes for window centering in STFT.

methods.name: stft
methods.description: Defines the symbolic representation of the torch.stft function for ONNX export, handling input preprocessing, window creation, and operator invocation.
